title: Kosher Crispy Mediterranean Chicken Skillet
description: A lazy Sunday Mediterranean dish featuring crispy chicken, mustardy flavor, and a blend of spices, all made in one skillet and kosher-friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, celery salt, garlic powder, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Dip each piece of chicken into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly, then place the coated chicken in the skillet.
Cook the chicken for 5-6 minutes on each side, or until browned and crispy, then remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, and lemon juice, stirring to combine and scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet.
Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon some of the yogurt sauce over the top of each piece.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill if desired.
